question.text: Which is part of the DYNAMIC section (Part II) of the Disclosure Document?

explanation.text: The Logic: Dynamic section covers client representation, financial performance, PM performance (TWRR), audit observations, related-party investments. The Trap: Other options belong to the Static section. Cross-Exam Context: SEBI Sep 2025 circular structure. Distributor's Pro-Tip: TWRR disclosure must match client reports; mismatches trigger audit flags.
